titulo: Si + pluperfect subjunctive + perfect conditional (past hypotheticals)
regla: For impossible conditions in the past: si + pluperfect subjunctive (hubiera / hubiese + participle), then the perfect conditional (habría + participle) or the pluperfect subjunctive again (hubiera + participle): Si hubiera llegado antes, habría / hubiera visto a Carlos.

bloques.texto: The condition **didn't happen**, so the result didn't either: _if I had known, I would have come_.
Result clause: **habría** + participle or **hubiera** + participle. Both are correct; **hubiera** is very common in Mexico.
Mixed time: past condition, present result: **si hubiera estudiado, ahora tendría trabajo**.
Tip: **si hubiera**... the door that stayed closed.

lista.es: ==Si hubiéramos ganado== la lotería, ==habríamos comprado== una casa en la playa.
lista.en: If we had won the lottery, we would have bought a beach house.

lista.es: ==Si hubiera llegado== antes, ==habría visto== a Carlos en la fiesta.
lista.en: If I'd arrived earlier, I would have seen Carlos at the party.

lista.es: ==Si hubiera llegado== antes, ==hubiera visto== a Carlos en la fiesta.
==Si hubieras firmado== ese contrato, ==te habrías arrepentido==.
lista.en: If you'd signed that contract, you'd have regretted it.

lista.es: ==Si te hubieras llevado== el paraguas, no ==te habrías mojado== tanto.
lista.en: If you'd taken the umbrella, you wouldn't have gotten so wet.

lista.es: ==Si hubiera estudiado==, ahora ==tendría== un mejor trabajo.
lista.en: If I had studied, I'd have a better job now.

filas.t: Si hubiera sabido, habría venido ayer.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _If you had called me, I would have helped you._
lista.r: Si me hubieras llamado, te habría ayudado. / te hubiera ayudado.

lista.p: Fix it: _Si habría tenido tiempo, habría ido._
lista.r: Si hubiera tenido tiempo, habría ido.

lista.p: Mixed: _If I had slept, I wouldn't be tired now._
lista.r: Si hubiera dormido, ahora no estaría cansado.
